item.title: Jerry Lynn Haag Sr.
item.description: Jerry Lynn Haag, Sr., 67, of Punxsutawney, passed away surrounded by his loving family on Wednesday, January 14, 2026, at Butler Memorial Hospital. He was born in DuBois on July 12, 1958, a son of the late George Sylvester Haag and Margaret Jane (Ruth) Haag. Jerry was a 1977 graduate of Punxsutawney Area High School.
